name: Easing Suffering

angles.text: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow is one of your own, stricken by a virulent corruption in the wilds of Teldrassil near the Oracle Tree. Bringing her comfort honours the duty Sentinels bear for their kin.
Aiding fallen night elf Sentinels along the roads of Darnassus's homeland helps preserve the fragile frontline against growing corruption in the boughs of Teldrassil.

faq.answer: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow is a night elf guardian found ailing along the road leading toward the Oracle Tree. Struck down by an aggressive, festering rot, she is incapacitated and near death when discovered.

Lashwater Salve is a prepared medicinal remedy delivered to ease the violent pain caused by the virulent rot afflicting Sentinel Eralya. While uncertain to cure the condition entirely, it soothes her distress.
The salve eases Sentinel Eralya's breathing and brings her relative peace, but it remains uncertain whether she will truly recover or succumb to the rot that took hold of her.
faq.q: Does Sentinel Eralya survive the affliction?

faq.answer: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow lies along the path leading toward the Oracle Tree, situated within the ancient reaches of Teldrassil.
faq.q: Where can Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow be found?

faq.answer: Eralya suffers from an aggressive and festering rot spreading rapidly through her body. The exact source of the taint is unspecified, but it attacks quickly and grows more virulent over time.
The rot festers and strengthens rapidly as it spreads through Eralya's body. Speed is necessary because every passing moment brings her closer to succumbing entirely to the agony and corruption.
faq.q: Why is haste required to deliver the salve?

sections.body: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow lies stricken by a rapidly spreading, festering rot on the road to the Oracle Tree. In an effort to halt her agonizing decline, a freshly concocted Lashwater Salve must be brought to her without delay before the affliction takes full hold.
sections.title: A Race Against the Rot

sections.body: While those treating her doubt whether the Lashwater Salve possesses the potency to completely eradicate the blight, administering it brings swift calm to Eralya's labored, gurgling breath. Though her survival remains in question, the treatment succeeds in granting her peace in her darkest hour.
sections.title: Peace in the Shadows

summary: Easing Suffering is a quest in Teldrassil centered on delivering emergency aid to Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow, who lies stricken by a virulent rot along the road to the Oracle Tree. Players rush Lashwater Salve to her side to ease her agony and bring peace to her failing breath.
